items.title: Fuel Pushes Thai Airways Into Q3 Loss as It Awaits New CEO
items.summary: Thai Airways' demand held up in the third quarter; its costs didn't. With fuel still high, a CEO still to be named and the fourth quarter likely to look similar, 2027 will be about protecting margins rather than pushing growth.

items.title: Italy’s WeRoad Lets Korean Superapp NOL Own Its Customers: Exclusive
items.summary: WeRoad is entering South Korea without selling a single trip directly, letting NOL own the customer. NOL handles bookings, payments and customer service, while WeRoad runs the trips. If it works, it could become the template for how Western tour operators get into Asia.
